dataset_title: Green Valleys high-sugar brown-juice nanofiltration reference observations
source_title: Status of demonstration facilities at AU Foulum and VGN Sötåsen; Green Valleys project meeting, 18 March 2020
authors: Morten Ambye-Jensen (presenter; individual authorship of extracted tables is not stated in the document)
source_location: Presentation sections titled High sugar grass brown juice filtration using pilot and demo plant, Average Retention at 15 bar using GE HL membrane, and demo-scale filtration description; web-extracted PDF lines 407-490.
document_type: public project technical presentation / grey literature
license: No explicit reuse license identified; factual values and short labels are transcribed with source attribution.

experimental_contexts.pilot: GE HL nanofiltration membrane, pilot plant area 2.6 m2; feed characterization table reports operation at 15 bar and 25 C. Feed, permeate and concentrate concentrations are provided; no stream volumes or component mass recoveries are reported.
experimental_contexts.demonstration: Separate GE HL demo-scale trial with 98 m2 membrane area; 2.03 m3 feed, 2.66 degree Brix, 15 bar and 30 C; concentrate volume 0.12 m3 and reported volume reduction factor 16.9. The presentation attributes low feed Brix mainly to pre-press washing water.

interpretation_and_limits: Pilot chemistry table and demo-scale concentration test are different experiments and must not be joined as if they share one feed composition or operating condition.
Concentration changes alone do not establish solute mass recovery, rejection, or retention without matched stream flow volumes and sample timing.
The reported 0.00 mg/L galactose and sucrose in permeate are retained as reported numeric values; analytical detection limits are not stated. Nondetect entries are retained as nd text, not zeros.
Degree Brix is a refractometric soluble-solids scale and is not treated as dry matter or a sugar-specific mass fraction.

No flux, filtration runtime, cleaning chemical use, membrane replacement interval, energy demand, or uncertainty is reported for the demo trial; these records cannot complete NF design or TEA/LCA inputs.
High-sugar grass brown juice from the Green Valleys platform is not confirmed to match GreenHub roadside grass residual juice; all records remain reference-only.
normalization: Values and units are transcribed as reported. No derived recoveries or conversions are included.
